title: Price Tracker
description: A freelance project that automates web crawling to fetch asset prices and export the data to a Google Sheet. Built with Python using Scrapy and deployed on AWS Lambda, with CloudWatch enabling automated execution.

title: Report Summary Telegram Bot
description: A freelance project that automates filtering Gmail emails, extracting PDF reports, and generating summaries using Python, Sumy, and Facebook's BART-Large-CNN model from Hugging Face. The summarized text is then delivered via a Telegram bot.

title: HDB Pricing Visualisation
description: The project aims to help people make meaningful decisions regarding HDB transaction prices by providing them with a simple and easy way to compare and filter transactions and visualise the data.
